program.name: HIIT Pyramid Long
program.subject: HIIT
program.blurb: HIIT pyramids: three ladders one day, two ladders and Tabatas the next.
program.about: Pyramids of reps, no equipment. One day climbs three ladders of a jump and a strength move, one rep each, then two, then three; the other climbs two ladders and then runs four Tabatas. They alternate. Abs finish every session. Level II brings harder variations and Level III adds reps.
